note: Both sets capture the same core facts accurately: the 4° maximum blade pitch at low wind speed, the 90 m force peak under below-rated wind speeds, the design-point TSR of 9.0 versus the optimal 8.5, and the Prandtl tip-loss explanation for the outboard 5% drop. Set A states each fact once and keeps the relevant conditions (design point, Region 1.5/low wind speed, maximum CP).
